title: GrowthBook header (v2)
description: A violet announcement strip over a light 80px nav: wordmark, links with small chevrons, a white stars pill, a quiet sign-in link and outline + violet buttons. Sticky; on desktop it slides away while you scroll down and returns when you scroll up. Phones get a burger that opens a full-width menu.
notes: needs JavaScript for the burger menu and the hide-on-scroll (hydrate: load)
name: growthbook-v2-header

props.name: announcement
props.type: { text: string; linkLabel: string; href: string; }
props.description: the strip above the nav; leave out to hide it

props.name: pill
props.type: { icon?: ReactNode; label: string; href: string; ariaLabel?: string; }
props.description: the round pill after the links, e.g. repository stars

props.name: signIn
props.description: the quiet text link before the buttons

props.name: actions
props.description: the buttons on the right, outline first

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the burger button, for screen readers
